title: Fervent
subtitle: Flammeus — fire, heat, pressure
text: Fervent blood is Flammeus in the older records: heat, flame, and relentless momentum. It is drawn from burned places, infernal creatures, and violent acts that leave warmth behind them. Blood shaped by Flammeus burns away hesitation and drives the practitioner toward overwhelming force. The Fervent enzyme gives that force a usable sign, but the tendency itself does not teach retreat.
